reply.text:
Knee pain is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't weigh in on what's causing the ache or whether it's safe to keep training through it. Get it looked at before you decide anything about landing or jumping.

What I can do is build your training around it. Tell me what you want to avoid and I'll put together a plan with the jumping work taken out, and I'll train around whatever a doctor or physio clears you for. Do you want me to look at your current program so we can see what's in it?
